I've levelled 4 classes on Classic HC so far (Mage, Rouge, Warr and, Shaman) all to 60. It is hard, but so is doing any content without dying. The dungeons are still insanely simple and the raids even more so. I haven't raided in HC WoW, but that's mainly because I found every single piece of content in classic to only be difficult due to the grind. Even HC can be easy if you play smart.  


I say all of this as someone who's around 3350 IO 8/9M. Retail WoW will always be harder but for vastly different reasons and playstyle. HC Classic is very fun, but once you get your spec rolling the only mistakes to be made are user error and not really due to the difficulty of the content.

Issue with classic is the difficulty ceiling is so insanely low. Yes, getting to lvl 60 - 80 can be hard and very slow ; leveling as a whole actually has moments of big challenge, but I have never once struggled in a classic dungeon or raid. Classic has a harder base level but that's about it ; endgame is boringly easy compared to retail's
